_how_to_edit: Payment links for the full-report paywall (shown only on full-report links that the lead sheet marks as 'Payment needed'). one = AED 19 single report, monthly = AED 49/month Premium. Paste the payment-link URLs from Stripe / Ziina here. While a link is empty, the button opens WhatsApp to Sam instead. agent = AED 199/month Agent Pro (30 projects), agent_unl = AED 299/month Agent Unlimited; the AED 19 'one' link is also the Agent Pro top-up. Used by /pricing/. Renewal discounts (existing paid agents only): renew on or before the plan's end date = 50% off (agent_r50 AED 99, agent_unl_r50 AED 149); renew 1-7 days after it ended = 25% off (agent_r25 AED 149, agent_unl_r25 AED 224); later = full price. Paste a Ziina link for each; while empty the button opens WhatsApp with the amount.
